content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Selling digital products such as ebooks, courses, and templates is a growing market, yet many creators are locked out due to payment processing limitations. Solana payments provide a decentralized method for creators to receive payments directly in cryptocurrency, enabling them to avoid the hefty fees and restrictions of platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale. By using NOWPayments with Solana, creators can benefit from a mere 0.5% fee, significantly improving their profit margins and allowing them to keep more of what they earn.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind Solana payments for digital products is built on a decentralized blockchain network that supports fast, low-cost transactions. When a customer purchases a digital product, NOWPayments processes the payment on-chain, instantly verifying the transaction. This process eliminates the need for an intermediary, allowing creators to receive payments directly in their cryptocurrency wallets. By leveraging tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automated delivery and Supabase for order management, creators can create a seamless purchasing experience while maintaining full control over their data.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This payment solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors are restricted. If you sell products such as presets, software, or digital templates, this architecture empowers you to operate independently without relying on platforms that charge high fees or require complex account setups. Solana payments cater to those who value sovereignty over their digital commerce, allowing creators to focus on their craft rather than navigating payment hurdles.
Retain more of your earnings with a 0.5% transaction fee.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this digital commerce stack include a hosting service like Cloudflare Pages, backend logic through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and payment processing via NOWPayments. Each piece plays a critical role: hosting delivers your digital products, the backend manages orders and automation, and NOWPayments ensures that payments are processed efficiently and at low cost. This combination allows creators to run an efficient online store with automatic delivery of their products, ensuring a frictionless experience for customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your digital products using Solana payments, first, choose the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from our store at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit includes all six blueprints and seven templates you need to build your sovereign digital commerce stack. Next, set up your hosting using Cloudflare Pages, implement backend logic with Google Apps Script, and integrate NOWPayments for processing transactions. Finally, upload your products and launch your store with confidence, knowing you have full control over your sales.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Automate product delivery seamlessly with backend scripts.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This package equips you with everything you need to set up a sovereign digital store, bypassing traditional payment processors entirely. It’s an ideal resource for creators ready to take control of their online commerce.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by using NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency. This method doesn't require traditional payment accounts, allowing you to receive payments directly in your wallet, minimizing fees.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

Using a decentralized payment processor like NOWPayments allows you to sell digital downloads with low transaction fees. This approach enables you to maximize your earnings by keeping more of the sale price.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up your own online store using the Complete Builder Kit. This solution eliminates the need for platforms like Gumroad, ensuring you retain full control.
What are the fees associated with using Solana payments?
When using NOWPayments with Solana for processing, the fee is only 0.5% per transaction. This is significantly lower than many traditional payment processors, which can charge up to 10%.
How can I automate delivery of my digital products?
You can automate delivery by using backend services like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. These tools enable you to send digital files to customers automatically upon payment confirmation.
